# Emulate Treatment Center

> > Emulate Treatment Center provides comprehensive outpatient substance abuse and addiction treatment with accredited mental health and behavioral health services in Woodland Hills, California.

Emulate Treatment Center is an accredited outpatient facility specializing in addiction recovery and mental health treatment through multiple program levels including PHP, IOP, and standard outpatient care. The center also operates Serenity Estates sober living homes and accepts most insurance plans for treatment services.

## Key Topics

- Outpatient Programs (PHP, IOP, OP)
- Substance Abuse Treatment
- Mental Health Services
- Addiction Recovery
- Behavioral Health Care
- Sober Living Homes
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Accreditation (The Joint Commission, BHCHSA)
- Insurance Verification
- Woodland Hills, California
- Serenity Estates
- Intensive Outpatient Program
- Partial Hospitalization Program
- HIPAA Compliance
- Department of Health Care Services

## Treatment Programs

- [Partial Hospitalization Programs For Mental Health](https://emulatecenter.com/partial-hospitalization-program-in-los-angeles): Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) for structured day treatment in Woodland Hills.
- [Intensive Outpatient Treatment Programs For Substance Abuse](https://emulatecenter.com/intensive-outpatient-program-iop): Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) for addiction recovery and mental health treatment.
- [Outpatient Mental Health Services & Programs](https://emulatecenter.com/outpatient-program-in-los-angeles): Outpatient Program (OP) for mental health and substance abuse treatment in LA.

## Residential & Housing Services

- [Trusted Sober Living Homes Near You](https://emulatecenter.com/sober-living-home-in-woodland-hills): Sober living homes at Serenity Estates in Woodland Hills for transitional housing.
